upper_derivation.claim: For every fixed full-dimensional compact convex K in R^n, n>=1, and fixed real polynomial f, the full normalized Lebesgue global-SOS density hierarchy with degree<=2r satisfies0<=H_r-min_K f<=C(K,f,n)/r^2 for every integer r>=1.
upper_derivation.strongest_verified_result: Complete existence theorem with explicit C=B(n+2)^2*4^(n+2)*(1+2^(3n+6)), B from the convex quadratic upper surrogate. Boundary minimizers, nonconvex objectives, nonsmooth bodies, constant objectives, small r, positive normalizer and global degree budget are covered.

optional_known_lower_clarification.claim: For K=[0,1],f=t, and for each fixed n>1,K=[0,1]x[-1,1]^(n-1),f(t,y)=t, H_r>=1/[4(r+1)^2] for every integer r>=1.
optional_known_lower_clarification.strongest_verified_result: A fixed sharpness instance in every dimension. With the general upper theorem, its error is Theta(r^-2); a universal o(r^-2) rate over all fixed instances is impossible.
optional_known_lower_clarification.notation: Read integer index as j and imaginary unit as iota. This implements the frozen proposal's own explicit instruction, not a newly discovered mathematical defect.
optional_known_lower_clarification.primary_known_rate_attribution: de Klerk and Laurent, arXiv:1804.05524v1, Section3.1, Theorem3.1, Corollaries3.2-3.3; Mathematics of Operations Research45(1):86-98 (2020), DOI10.1287/moor.2018.0983.
